title: Ghosts, Reality TV and Recipes: Amy Bruni Spills the Tea

content:
SALT LAKE CITY, Utah (Spill the Tea with Deena Marie) — Episode 30 is Amy Bruni who you’ll recognize as the paranormal researcher from reality TV hits, Ghost Hunters and Kindred Spirits. Deena and Amy tell us how the two met, introduced by a mutual friend over a decade ago right here in Salt Lake City at FanX when Deena agreed to help Amy at her booth.

It’s a reunion for the two in SLC again, when Amy passed through on her way to another convention, Phenomicon. We had to grab her while we had the chance, so we could learn her lore. Her first paranormal experience, her stints on reality TV, and the release of her beautiful second cookbook that blends delicious recipes with true crime tales. Plus, she hints at what the future holds, and we’re excited. Think tips on how to meet a ghost, and even more reality tv.

We’ll take all the Amy we can. Follow her on IG @amybruni and shop wherever books are sold for Cuisine to Kill or grab on Amazon here.
